title: WHEN TROUBLE SURGES
GOD LIFTS A STANDARD
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: That rushing wave of trouble feels overwhelming today.
So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun.
When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
Lord God, when sudden trials surge like a dark tide, stand between us and the danger.
scenes.sub: STAND BETWEEN US AND THE STORM

scenes.a: Raise Your holy standard over this life and silence every threat that rises against us.
Hold us steady under the divine shield of Your presence.
Amen. Even when trouble rushes in like a flood.
